dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Grok 4.7 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge, indicating limited actionable uplift for an already-trained actor.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 7 Biological and chemical capabilities and safeguards

dc_eval_cyber.quote: CyberGym measures offensive cybersecurity capability by tasking an agent with reproducing crashes and assembling working exploits for known vulnerabilities.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: SWE-Marathon and long-horizon coding are capability benchmarks, not evaluated as an autonomy risk; no AI R&D risk evaluation (FrontierSWE V2 lists AI research tasks only as a capability set).

dc_eval_scheming.note: MASK dishonesty and sycophancy framed as reliability and truth-seeking behaviour, not misalignment risk.

framework_threshold.quote: Grok 4.7 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge
framework_threshold.locator: 7 Biological and chemical capabilities and safeguards
framework_threshold.note: Names the xAI Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework and places model below its thresholds.

ext_test_any.quote: We additionally provided an unrestricted configuration of Grok 4.7 to third-party evaluators, who corroborated the results of our internal evaluations and testing on cyber capabilities.
ext_test_any.note: Third-party cyber red-team evaluation including CathedralBench.

ext_test_named_org.quote: CathedralBench is an independent, third party evaluation of cyber performance. It consists of a red-team cyber evaluation on highly-difficult, multiple-exploit chain execution tasks
ext_test_named_org.note: Cathedral is also thanked in Acknowledgements as an evaluation partner.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: No statement that the third-party cyber evaluation occurred before release.

safeguards_training.quote: Safety fine-tuning and post-training (supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning from human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model-based grading) train the model to refuse requests that show clear intent to cause severe harm or engage in criminal activity.

safeguards_runtime.quote: Grok 4.7 is additionally augmented with runtime input and topical filters that add controls for classes of severe harm, including CSAM, self-harm, and biological/chemical weapons pathways
